purpose: Production building and machinery layers; original alpha preserved by packing tool

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Turn the selected building from the attached OPTION B reference into a production layered game sprite asset sheet. Reference is the exact approved architecture, palette, material and camera. Preserve its identity faithfully. Output a 1536x1024 landscape image with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, no backdrop or checkerboard painted into it, no text, labels, borders, floor tile or ground shadow. Technical layout: LEFT TWO THIRDS (x=0..1023) contain ONE large intact stationary building, fully visible with margin, no other objects in that area. RIGHT THIRD (x=1100..1535) contains separate isolated moving machinery pieces, neatly separated vertically with clear transparent space between them. These detached pieces are NOT installed in the left main building. Same 3/4 elevated orthographic camera and hand-painted detail as reference. Nothing cropped, no smoke, no sparkles, no light halo: smoke and lighting will be added at runtime. Main building must be fully painted BEHIND removed moving parts (wood/stone/iron supports), no missing alpha holes inside building. Neutral stonework and no terrain mat or vegetation. All contact debris tightly hugs the walls; accessible doorway at front center. This asset will fill a three-tile-wide two-tile-deep ground footprint. Only LEFT WOOD sawmill from reference. Preserve gray limestone ground floor arched entrance, upstairs timber saw workshop under slate roof, chimney on left, stacked wood. On main building REMOVE the large left flywheel and the exposed circular saw blade but retain their stationary axle bearings and supports. Keep the log carriage and timber stocks installed and still. RIGHT UPPER isolated piece: that same six-spoke dark iron/bronze flywheel facing the same oblique angle, centered around x=1300,y=245, occupying max 300x350; no axle or stand extending away, only rotating wheel. RIGHT LOWER isolated piece: circular toothed silver/dark iron saw blade as seen in reference in matching oblique plane, centered x=1300,y=735, max250x250; no stand/logs. Main lantern glass amber but no glow halo.
